messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-03-11] standup/ember/2025-03-11: Policy: every the auth gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.
- [2025-07-01] handover/2025-07-01-auth-gateway: Quick one: the auth gateway belongs to team Cinder starting today. Thanks to the Ember team for running it until now.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20-2: The authentication gateway lives with team Ember.
- [2025-03-14] standup/atlas/2025-03-14: Dependency map update: the ledger needs the auth gateway (service tokens).
- [2025-11-10] standup/ember/2025-11-10: Heads-up from team Ember: the authentication gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.
- [2025-04-10] standup/ember/2025-04-10: Reminder: the authentication gateway is owned by the Ember team.
- [2025-04-14] standup/ember/2025-04-14: Auth-gateway deploy window: on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.
- [2025-11-17] standup/ember/2025-11-17: Team Ember saw that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it. The weekly architecture review is run by Oskar.
- [2026-02-10] standup/boreal/2026-02-10: Reminder: the authentication gateway deploys only on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.
- [2025-07-18] handover/2025-07-18-auth-gateway-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-07-01: auth-gateway went to team Boreal, not the Cinder team. Cinder never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2026-01-27] standup/boreal/2026-01-27: Auth-gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. Rationale: the security audit flagged long-lived tokens.
- [2026-04-17] standup/cinder/2026-04-17: Observation from the Cinder team: after the runtime upgrade, the authentication gateway's cold start time tripled.
- [2025-07-03] standup/atlas/2025-07-03: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.
- [2025-03-11] standup/ember/2025-03-11-2: Observation from team Ember: after the cache change, the webhooks service's memory use grew steadily for a week. Team Ember now does pairing on every production change.
- [2025-07-09] incident-review/INC-2025-017: Incident review INC-2025-017. Auth-gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-07-06. Root cause: an expired intermediate certificate. Decision: certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, because an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017.
- [2025-09-16] standup/atlas/2025-09-16: Decision: webhooks will sign payloads with rotating keys, because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review.
- [2025-09-09] handover/2025-09-09-webhooks: The Ember team handed the webhook dispatcher to team Atlas today; Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Priya.
- [2026-04-29] handover/2026-04-29-ledger: Cinder is taking over the ledger from team Boreal, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-06-25] handover/2025-06-25-reporting: Ownership change: the reports pipeline now sits with team Ember. The Dune team no longer owns it.
- [2025-04-11] handover/2025-04-11-webhooks: Quick one: webhooks belongs to team Ember starting today. Thanks to Boreal for running it until now.
- [2025-02-13] handover/2025-02-13-feature-flags: Handover: as of today the flags service moves from team Atlas to the Cinder team. Priya walked Diego through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-10-21] standup/atlas/2025-10-21: New dependency for the billing service: the feature flag service. Billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags; the reasoning is that the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch.
- [2025-12-24] handover/2025-12-24-billing-api: Handover: as of today the billing service moves from the Atlas team to team Boreal. Priya walked Lena through the runbook this morning.
- [2026-01-29] handover/2026-01-29-feature-flags: Handover: as of today the feature flag service moves from Cinder to team Dune. Yuki walked Farah Haddad through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-25: reporting went to Boreal, not Ember. Team Ember never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-12-10] handover/2025-12-10-ledger: Atlas handed the ledger to the Boreal team today; Priya wrote up the handover doc for Lena.
- [2026-03-05] standup/boreal/2026-03-05: As before, billing-api needs Ledger to work.
- [2025-04-18] incident-review/INC-2025-011: Incident review INC-2025-011. Ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-13. Root cause: an index missing after the schema migration. Decision: ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan, because a missing index after a migration caused INC-2025-011.
